reader_summary.overview: Brad Briner is the leading candidate for the Treasurer of North Carolina in the upcoming November election. Brad put himself in the ring for the seat after twenty-five years of investment experience, serving most recently as Co-CIO of Willett Advisors. For more background on Willett, my conversation from 2019 with Chairman Steve Rattner is replayed in the feed.

key_points.text: Brad Briner is the leading candidate for the Treasurer of North Carolina in the upcoming November election.
Brad put himself in the ring for the seat after twenty-five years of investment experience, serving most recently as Co-CIO of Willett Advisors.
